messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — spotted a corner-case when deprecating v1 routing. In the canary rollout we see tenant bursts that cause the proxy to increment both v1 and v2 quota counters for the same effective request. This leads to duplicate billing and tenants hitting their quota unexpectedly. Anyone run into this?

sam: ugh. can you paste an example log?

anya: sure, from canary proxy log: 
```
proxy: received X-Api-Version: v2 but route fallback hit v1
billing: increment tenant/123 tokens: +453 (v1)
billing: increment tenant/123 tokens: +453 (v2)
```

ben: that's because during the handshake we try v2 then fallback to v1, and both attempts emit billing events. we added `X-Version-Affinity` but some older proxies still emit a `v1-fallback` tag that the billing path currently treats as a unique charge.

marta: telemetry shows fallback events but we didn't link them to billing IDs, so it looks like two independent requests.

leo: two quick mitigations: make billing idempotent by request signature (request_id + preferred_version) and surface a console panel for "compat.double_billing / 24h" per tenant. we should prefer idempotency in billing rather than changing routing behavior mid-rollout.

sam: agree, we shouldn't change billing semantics without finance sign-off. suggest a shadow/batch dedupe first.

anya: proposed rollout plan:
- add `compatibility_request_id` to proxy for all handshake attempts
- update billing path to check recent (30s) request_id dedupe before incrementing counters
- add console panel: "compat.double_billing / 24h" and per-tenant drilldown
- CI integration test that simulates handshake flapping between v1/v2
- enable 1% sampling of this telemetry in prod for 48h before broader rollout

ben: note on dedupe: window must be keyed by tenant+model+req_sig to avoid rejecting legitimate retries across different models or tenants. also watch memory usage for dedupe cache.

marta: UX idea: in the model route view add an "affinity timeline" showing which version served each token-range, with a compact breadcrumb for fallback events. toggle to show only double-counted incidents.

console-bot: deploy job queued: canary/proxy/compat-fix -> merging to staging at 2026-03-21T14:40Z

leo: telemetry metric suggestions to add:
- compat.handshake_attempts.count
- compat.double_billing.count
- compat.handshake_latency.p50|p95
- billing.dedupe_hits.count

sam: experiment idea: run dedupe logic in shadow mode for 7 days (not affecting billing) then compare revenue delta and false-positive retries. also coordinate with finance for rounding/retro adjustments if needed.

anya: action owners:
- proxy changes: ben
- billing dedupe + finance sync: sam
- console panels: marta
- telemetry + sampling: leo
- tests + canary: ben & anya

ben: i'll open the PR today and tag @marta for the dashboard wireframe.

marta: will mock the panel in Figma and link the prototype in the PR.

leo: FYI this primarily hits tenants with concurrent multi-route fallbacks — estimated ~0.3% of traffic but high impact when it happens.

anya: thanks all. please ack here when you add the tasks to your boards and include a short blurb in the v1 sunset runbook release notes.

sam: will coordinate a quick finance sync tomorrow 09:30 PST.

marta: added roadmap card and set priority P1 for dashboard.

anya: :thumbsup: everyone

console-bot: CI status: compat/proxy-tests — queued

ben: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/r/proxy/merge_requests/412 (WIP)

sam: acknowledged, i'll draft the finance note and share in #finance-sync.

anya: closing loop — we'll reconvene after the 1% shadow run and a first batch of dedupe metrics.
